title: Pyare Nabi ke Pyare Hussain
body:
Hussain a.s (x2)
Karbala Ishqe Manasto Manum, Ghulam E Hussain
Hussain, Mola Hussain Ya Hussain (x3)
<<MINI>>
Mola Imam Hussain, Salam Hussain (x2)
Maha E Aza, Farsh E Aza
Ishq E Aza, Ehle E Aza
Maha E Aza, Farsh E Aza
Ishq E Aza, Ehle E Aza
<<DIVIDER>>
Sub Muntazir Hain Aapk
Kya Hukum Hai Hussain a.s
Zawwar Ro Rahay Hai
Inko Galay Laga Lai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Karbala K Malik
Karbobala Bula Le
Karbobala Bula Le

Imam HUSSAIN, Salam HUSSAIN a.s
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Har Matami Ka Dil Yeh Sada Dai Raha Hai
Karbobala Se Sanso Ka Rishta Juda Hai
Hum Rahay Na Rahay Bus Rahay Karbobala
Raho Say Pehray Hata Dejiye (x2)
Bechain Aashiq Hai Sare Hussain
<<MINI>>
Pyare Nabi Ke Pyare Hussain
Karbobala Phir Bula Le Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
(x2)
<<MINI>>

2. Farzand E Zera Yeh Aarzo Hai Hamari
Qadmo Mai Teray Kat Jae Yeh Umr Sari
Senay Mai Dil Dil Mai Tera Haram Ya HUSSAIN
Ik Baar Phir Kijiye, Hum Pr Karam Ya HUSSAIN
Qismat Hamari Jaga Kr Hamay (x2)
Dedar Apna Karay De HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>

3.Sara Zamana, Hai Karbala Ka Diwana Or Kabala Ka, Hai Yeh HUSSAINI Tarana
Labaik Ya HUSSAIN, Labaik Ya HUSSAIN
Hur Ban K Karbobala Ayengay (x2)
Ik Bar Humko Sada De HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
Pyare Nabi Ke Pyare Hussain
Karbobala Phir Bula Le Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
(x2)
<<MINI>>

4.Rozay Pay Teray, Parchum Kushaei Ka Manzar
Ghazi Jo Chahey, Dekhey Azadar Ja Kr
Ya Aba Abdillah, Teray Aashiq Wallah
Janib E Karbobala Dekh Rahay Hai
Kaisay Huway Hai Sb Matami (x2)
Jager E Akbar Dikha De HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
Pyare Nabi Ke Pyare Hussain
Karbobala Phir Bula Le Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
(x2)
<<MINI>>
Imam HUSSAIN, Salam HUSSAIN a.s
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Murshid Hamaray Tu Bhi To Mushkil Kusha Hai
Hai Badshahe Kono Makan Iltija Hai
Syeda Ka Wasta, Sabeel Yhe Kara De Ya HUSSAIN
Hum Mai Or Karbala Mai Faslay Mita De Ya HUSSAIN
Parwaz Humko Ata Kr Sakhi (x2)
Phitrus Ko Pr Denay Walay HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
Pyare Nabi Ke Pyare Hussain
Karbobala Phir Bula Le Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
(x2)
<<MINI>>
Imam HUSSAIN, Salam HUSSAIN a.s

6.Wo Din Bhi Aye, Farsh E Aza Hum Bichaye
Nohay Sunaye Matam K Halqay Banaye
Bainul Harame, Bainul Harame
HUSSAIN HUSSAIN HUSSAIN (x2)
Sabit Karengay K Aashiq Hai Hum (x2)
Apnay Lahu Mai Naha K HUSSAIN
<<MINI>>
Pyare Nabi Ke Pyare Hussain
Karbobala Phir Bula Le Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
(x2)
<<MINI>>
Imam HUSSAIN, Salam HUSSAIN a.s
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Ehsan Hia Yeh Tera, Sultan E Karbobala
Shama Se Shama Jali, Badhta Raha Qafla
Akhtar O Irfan E Aza, Shamso Qamar Aabo Hawa
Jin O Bashar Arzo Sama, Muktsaran Khalq E Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
Sub Mntazir Hai Aapk, Kya Hukum Hai HUSSAIN a.s
HUSSAIN Aap Pr Durood, HUSSAIN Aap Pr Salam
Khuda Yeh Keh K Bhejta Hai Subh O Sham
Sallalahu Alaika Ya HUSSAIN (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalamun Aleyka Ya Aba Abdill HUSSAIN a.s
